name: EN project status update — informational only
transcript:
[00:00:05] Sarah: Thanks everyone for joining the weekly status call. Let me run through where we are.
[00:00:12] Sarah: The data migration is 75% complete. We are on track for the September 30th deadline.
[00:00:20] James: Good to hear. Any blockers to report?
[00:00:24] Sarah: One minor dependency on the API team for the authentication module. Tom, can you confirm the ETA?
[00:00:32] Tom: We are on track. The auth module will be ready by September 25th, which gives you five days of buffer.
[00:00:40] Sarah: Perfect. On the testing side, we have completed 80% of the test cases. Remaining test cases will be finished by September 27th.
[00:00:50] James: Great progress. Any budget concerns?
[00:00:54] Sarah: We are within budget. Current spend is 82% of the allocated amount with two weeks remaining.
[00:01:02] James: Excellent. Keep up the good work. Please send the weekly status report to the stakeholders by end of day.
[00:01:10] Sarah: Will do. I will circulate the report by 5pm today.

summary: Data migration is 75% complete and on track for the September 30th deadline.
Auth module dependency will be resolved by September 25th, providing five days of buffer.
Testing is 80% complete; remaining cases finish by September 27th. Budget spend at 82%.

action_items.task: Send weekly status report to stakeholders
